name: LumericalFDTD
description: Ansys Lumerical FDTD Python API automation and deep academic paper analysis. FDTD: photonics design, diffraction analysis, metasurfaces, waveguides, gratings, TGV structures — generates Python scripts, runs them against Lumerical's built-in Python interpreter, debugs errors autonomously, and delivers .fsp files and result charts. Paper analysis: 7 autonomous agents (reader, math, vision, experiment, critic, research, comparison) in a 4-phase pipeline for full analysis, figure interpretation, cross-paper comparison, and structured export (reading notes, PPT outlines, review materials). Tuned for infrared, optics, TGV, thermal imaging, machine vision, and physics/engineering.
